item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 11/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure is expected to edge closer to the coast of southern China gradually tomorrow, and bring a few showers and thunderstorms to the region. An easterly airstream will reach the coast of Guangdong on Monday. Windier over the region in the following few days. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be a few showers over southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
